provenance_notes: DataMeet Maps provides administrative, electoral, and statistical boundary datasets.
DataMeet boundaries serve as authoritative geographic reference / Area of Interest (AOI) base layers.
DataMeet datasets do NOT contain cadastral parcel boundaries or building footprints.
Cadastral physical building footprints are extracted from OpenStreetMap and spatially associated with DataMeet administrative units.
